summary: Select hierarchy, composition, and anti-slop review together for a rendered visual-restraint correction.

task.goal: Review and correct the rendered incident workbench so semantic color, background layers, responsive adaptation, scroll ownership, state distinction, icon weight, content density, and attention hierarchy remain quiet, current, and coherent.
acceptanceCriteria: Rendered evidence has an explicit canvas and bounded persistent layers.
One interactive accent and exceptional semantic states preserve a clear attention order.
Current, hover, focus, selected, populated, empty, and error states never contradict one another.
Modal navigation has a complete focus contract and local overflow has an intentional scroll owner.
Dominant regions and persistent icons remain proportionate to their task value.
constraints: Preserve project-owned tokens, components, behavior, and task-specific product character.
nonGoals: Do not impose one generic house style or copy an unrelated trend.

acceptedFailureEvidence.summary: Routine metadata and statuses compete through saturated color.
Tinted canvas and nested surfaces obscure persistent layer roles.
The screen defaults to an ungrounded legacy admin composition.
The workbench composition does not fit the operational task.
Modal focus, interaction-state distinction, or local scroll ownership is incomplete.
Color and generic shell styling substitute for product-specific objects and workflows.
